therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Adenovirus vector delivers IL-12 gene intratumorally, activated by oral veledimex to induce local IL-12 expression
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhance anti-tumor immune response through IL-12-mediated T-cell activation and interferon-gamma production

results.target_engagement_evidence: IL-12 mRNA expression increased up to 162,946-fold in tumors; vector copy numbers detected up to 140,000,000 copies per 100ng DNA
biomarker_changes: IL-12 mRNA expression increased dramatically in tumors (up to 162,946-fold)
IFN-gamma mRNA expression increased up to 417-fold
Vector persistence demonstrated across multiple cycles
safety_signals: Grade 3+ drug-related TEAEs in 53% of patients at higher doses
One death at 160mg QD dose level
Dose-limiting toxicities observed including pancytopenia, mental status changes

dose_info.dose: INXN-2001: 1.0 x 10^12 viral particles; INXN-1001: 5-160 mg
dose_info.schedule: INXN-2001: one intratumoral injection per cycle; INXN-1001: daily x7 days per cycle
dose_info.dose_modifications: Phase II included QOD dosing at 160mg, 120mg, 80mg due to toxicity
